# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

## Punjabi (pa)

Script: Gurmukhi. Used in Punjab and Chandigarh, and spoken in Delhi and
Haryana.
Tone: everyday spoken Punjabi.
Words: ਆਨਲਾਈਨ, ਫਾਰਮ, ਪੋਰਟਲ, ਲੌਗਇਨ, ਆਧਾਰ, ਬੈਂਕ, ਮੋਬਾਈਲ, OTP, ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ,
ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ, ਅਪਲੋਡ.
UI: ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਓ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ, ਅੱਗੇ, ਪਿੱਛੇ, ਖੋਜੋ, ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰੋ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਮਦਦ.

Gender: ਲਿੰਗ. Money: ₹6,000; ₹8 ਲੱਖ. September: ਸਤੰਬਰ.

## Odia (or)

Script: Odia. Used in Odisha.
Tone: everyday spoken Odia.
Words: ଅନଲାଇନ, ଫର୍ମ, ପୋର୍ଟାଲ, ଲଗଇନ, ଆଧାର, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, ମୋବାଇଲ, OTP, ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ, ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ,
ଡାଉନଲୋଡ, ଅପଲୋଡ.
UI: ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଦାଖଲ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ, ପଛକୁ, ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ସେୟାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ସେଟିଂସ୍, ଭାଷା, ସାହାଯ୍ୟ.

Gender: ଲିଙ୍ଗ. Money: ଟ.6,000; ଟ.8 ଲକ୍ଷ. September: ସେପ୍ଟେମ୍ବର.

## Tamil (ta)

Script: Tamil. Used in Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, and spoken in the Andamans.
Tone: plain everyday Tamil an elder in a village follows. Avoid both heavy
literary Tamil and slang.
Words: ஆன்லைன், படிவம், போர்ட்டல், லாகின், ஆதார், வங்கி, மொபைல், OTP, உதவி எண், சான்றிதழ்,
டவுன்லோடு, அப்லோடு.
UI: விண்ணப்பிக்கவும், சமர்ப்பிக்கவும், அடுத்து, பின்செல், தேடு, பகிர், அமைப்புகள், மொழி, உதவி.
Offices: தாசில்தார் (வட்டாட்சியர்), கிராம நிர்வாக அலுவலர் (VAO), கிராம ஊராட்சி, மாவட்ட
ஆட்சியர், இ-சேவை மையம்.
Gender: பாலினம். Money: ரூ.6,000; ரூ.8 லட்சம். September: செப்டம்பர்.

## Telugu (te)

Script: Telugu. Used in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, and in Yanam

Tone: everyday spoken Telugu.
Words: ఆన్‌లైన్, ఫారం, పోర్టల్, లాగిన్, ఆధార్, బ్యాంక్, మొబైల్, OTP, హెల్ప్‌లైన్, సర్టిఫికెట్,

UI: దరఖాస్తు చేయండి, సమర్పించండి, తదుపరి, వెనుకకు, వెతకండి, షేర్ చేయండి, సెట్టింగ్‌లు, భాష, సహాయం.

Gender: లింగం. Money: రూ.6,000; రూ.8 లక్షలు. September: సెప్టెంబర్.

## Kannada (kn)

Script: Kannada. Used in Karnataka.
Tone: everyday spoken Kannada.
Words: ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್, ಅರ್ಜಿ ನಮೂನೆ / ಫಾರ್ಮ್, ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್, ಲಾಗಿನ್, ಆಧಾರ್, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್, ಮೊಬೈಲ್, OTP,
ಸಹಾಯವಾಣಿ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರ, ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್, ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್.

items.t: Open bm-sgsw.ap.gov.in/BM/DeepamStatus. Enter your rice card or LPG consumer number and the captcha to see if your family is eligible.
If you are shown ineligible, go to your Village or Ward Secretariat with the rice card, gas book and Aadhaar and ask for it to be checked.
Complete LPG e-KYC at your gas agency and make sure the connection holder's bank account is seeded with Aadhaar.
In each four-month block (April–July, August–November, December–March), book one cylinder with your gas agency in the usual way.
Pay the delivery person the price printed on the bill and keep the bill.
The full amount is refunded to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account, usually within 48 hours. Check your passbook or the bank SMS.
If the refund does not come, check the status page again and call the Civil Supplies helpline 1967.
1967 / 1800-425-2977 — AP Civil Supplies helpline / 1902 — AP government citizen helpline
Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana (CMAAY Card)
State Health Agency (Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Society), Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Arunachal Pradesh

Arunachal's own health cover of Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals inside and outside the state. It is for APST families, state government employees and pensioners, non-APST Resident Certificate holders of Changlang, Lohit and Namsai, and accredited journalists, and it runs side by side with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Enrolment is free: apply on the CMAAY portal or the Arogya Arunachal app, or at the CMAAY kiosk in a district hospital or a CSC, then download the e-card. The old APCMUHIS smart card is no longer valid, so families must enrol again under CMAAY.
Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless (Rs.1 lakh secondary care + Rs.4 lakh tertiary care)
Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) families living in the state
Regular state government employees and state pensioners, with their dependent family members
Non-APST permanent residents of Changlang, Lohit and Namsai districts who hold a Resident Certificate (RC)
Working journalists accredited with the Arunachal Pradesh Union of Working Journalists (APUWJ) or the Arunachal Press Club
Not for Central Government or PSU employees
No income limit. The Rs.1 lakh secondary and Rs.4 lakh tertiary limits cannot be swapped, and treatment outside the state needs a referral from a government hospital, except in emergencies
APST (tribe) certificate issued by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, for APST families
Resident Certificate (RC), for non-APST families of Changlang, Lohit and Namsai
Ration card or family tree certificate showing the family members
Government employees: employee ID card and the family declaration form countersigned by the DDO or Head of Office; pensioners: PPO
Journalists: accreditation certificate from APUWJ or the Arunachal Press Club
Choose Public for APST and RC families. Government employees, state pensioners and journalists pick their own type.
Aadhaar of the head of the family. The OTP goes to the mobile linked with it, and you can create or fetch the ABHA number here.
Exactly as written on the Aadhaar card, in capital letters.
Father's name, or husband's name for a married woman.
As on Aadhaar. The age is filled in by itself.
Relation is how this person is related to the head of the family. The head is always Self.
A number you keep with you. Messages about approval come here.
Ration Card No. / Ration Card Type
Copy the number from the ration card and tick APL or BPL as printed on it.
Permanent Address, Pin Code, District, Circle, Village
Doimukh, 791112, Papum Pare, Doimukh Circle, Doimukh
Your permanent address in Arunachal, as on the ST certificate or RC.
ST Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Family Self Declaration
Upload a clear photo or PDF of each. RC holders upload the RC instead of the ST certificate. Employees also upload the DDO certificate.
Open the CMAAY portal and click Apply Online under Enrollment. Choose your enrolment type: Public, Government Employee, State Pensioner or State Working Journalist.
Enter the Aadhaar number of the head of the family and verify with the OTP. Create or fetch the ABHA number when asked.
Fill in the head of the family's details, then add each family member with their own Aadhaar and their relation to the head.
Upload the ST certificate or RC, the Aadhaar cards and the family declaration, then submit. Note the reference number. Enrolment is free.
The State Health Agency checks the documents. Use Check Status on the portal, and Reply To Query if they ask for anything more.
Once approved, download and print the CMAAY e-card. If you get stuck online, go to the CMAAY kiosk at the district hospital or a CSC with the same documents.

At an empanelled hospital, show the e-card to the Arogya Mitra. Treatment is cashless. For a hospital outside Arunachal, first get a referral from a government hospital (PHC, CHC or district hospital), unless it is an emergency.
1800 233 5558 — CMAAY toll-free / 08956048405 — CMAAY helpline / 9402914555 — CMAAY WhatsApp / 14555 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline
Ayushman Asom – Mukhya Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AA-MMJAY Ayushman Card)
Atal Amrit Abhiyan Society, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Assam

Free, cashless hospital treatment of up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family at empanelled government and private hospitals in Assam. It covers about 26 lakh NFSA ration card families who are not on the Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY list, with the same treatment packages. It replaced the older Atal Amrit Abhiyan health card, which was merged into it in 2023. The card is made by Aadhaar e-KYC, done by ASHA workers and other frontline staff at home or at camps.
Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at over 300 empanelled hospitals
Families listed in Assam's NFSA (ration card) database who are not already covered by Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
Of about 56 lakh NFSA families, about 30 lakh are under PM-JAY and the other 26 lakh under AA-MMJAY
Every member named on the ration card is covered. There is no limit on family size or age
All PM-JAY treatment packages are included: 1,949 procedures in 27 specialities
Government employees and pensioners are not covered here; they have the separate AA-MMLSAY scheme
Aadhaar card of each member who needs a card
Mobile number (if it is linked to Aadhaar, OTP e-KYC is quicker)

There is no paper form. Ask your ASHA worker, MPW, Bima Sakhi or Digipay Sakhi to do the AA-MMJAY e-KYC at your home or at the village camp. You can also go to the Ayushman desk (Arogya Mitra) of any empanelled hospital, the district kiosk at the medical college or civil hospital, or a Common Service Centre. Take the NFSA ration card, the Aadhaar card of each member and your mobile phone. Each member must be present for Aadhaar OTP or face authentication.
The operator can search by ration card, Aadhaar or name. The ration card finds the whole family at once.
Copy it from the NFSA ration card. If nothing is found, try the head of family's Aadhaar.
The list shows whether your family is under PM-JAY or AA-MMJAY. Both give the same Rs.5 lakh cover.
Each member is done one by one. Pick the person who is sitting with the operator.
The Aadhaar of this member. Children need their own Aadhaar too.
Use OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise face authentication or fingerprint.
Face straight, good light, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the card rejected.
Any working number in the family. Approval messages come here.
How this person is related to the first name on the ration card.
Where you live now, so nearby empanelled hospitals are shown.
Check whether your family is on the list by asking your ASHA worker or calling 14555 with the ration card number. NFSA families not under PM-JAY fall under AA-MMJAY.
Get the e-KYC done by the ASHA, MPW, Bima Sakhi or Digipay Sakhi at home or at a camp, or at the Ayushman desk of an empanelled hospital or the district kiosk.
The operator finds your family, verifies each member with Aadhaar OTP or a face scan, and takes a live photo.
The request goes to the Atal Amrit Abhiyan Society for approval. Once approved, the operator gives you the Ayushman card.
When you need treatment, go to the Arogya Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital with the card or Aadhaar. The hospital takes approval before treatment, and you pay nothing for a listed procedure.
If a hospital asks for money or refuses the card, call 1800-103-9975 or 14555.
1800-103-9975 — Atal Amrit Abhiyan toll-free (PM-JAY and MMJAY) / 14555 — national Ayushman helpline / 0361-2333603 — Atal Amrit Abhiyan Society office, Guwahati
Finance (Institutional Finance) Department, Government of Assam

Assam's monthly cash support for poor families, paid straight into the bank account of one woman the family nominates. It pays Rs.1,250 a month to about 37 to 40 lakh families, and for October 2026 alone the government raised it to Rs.1,500 for the Puja season. Orunodoi 3.0 replaced the earlier versions 1.0 and 2.0, so every family, old beneficiaries included, had to apply afresh. Names are first picked at the Gaon Panchayat, VCDC or ward level, and the family needs an Aadhaar-seeded NFSA ration card.
Rs.1,250 a month by DBT to the woman of the family (Rs.1,500 for October 2026)
Permanent resident of Assam who lives in the state now
The family holds an NFSA ration card seeded with Aadhaar, and its income is within the NFSA limit of the Assam Food Security Rules
The family nominates one woman aged 18 or above. The money goes only to her own Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Priority for widows, divorced or separated women, unmarried women above 45, families with a divyang or transgender member, and families living with thalassemia, HIV or leprosy
Not for families with a serving or retired government or PSU employee, a current or former MP or MLA, a current panchayat or municipal member, or an income-tax payer
Also left out: families of doctors, engineers, lawyers and chartered accountants, families owning a motorised four-wheeler, and landholders above the small and marginal farmer category
NFSA ration card of the family, seeded with Aadhaar
Aadhaar card of the nominated woman
Passbook of her own bank account, seeded with Aadhaar (payments are now made through the Aadhaar-based payment system)
Mobile number, preferably the one linked to her Aadhaar
Proof for a priority category, if any: husband's death certificate, divorce papers, or disability (UDID) certificate
Signed undertaking on the eligibility conditions, filled at the Gaon Panchayat or ward office

Your Gaon Panchayat office (the VCDC office in Sixth Schedule areas, or the ward or municipal office in towns), when the government opens a round for new names. The form is free there, and the Orunodoi Sarothi of your Assembly constituency helps you fill it. Go with the nominated woman and take the Aadhaar-seeded ration card, her Aadhaar card, her Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook, a mobile phone, and any widow, divorce or disability papers. Get a signed acknowledgement slip. There is no online application, so do not pay anyone who offers to apply online for you.
Exactly as on her Aadhaar card and in her bank account. The money goes only to her.
Write the husband's name if she is married, otherwise the father's name.
In a town, write the municipality or town committee name instead.
The village or ward where the family actually lives and eats together.
Copy it from the ration card. Her name should be on this card.
The nominated woman's 12-digit Aadhaar number.
Her own account, seeded with Aadhaar. A joint account or someone else's account will be rejected.
SMS about wrong bank details or approval comes to this number.
Tick widow, divorced, separated, unmarried above 45, divyang or transgender member if it applies, and attach the proof.
Number of members on the ration card
Count everyone listed on the ration card. Only one woman per family can get Orunodoi.

Watch for a new Orunodoi round announced in the newspapers, on the Gaon Panchayat notice board or by your Orunodoi Sarothi. Women already getting the money do not need to apply again unless they are asked to.
Collect the free form at the Gaon Panchayat, VCDC or ward office. Fill it with the nominated woman's details, attach the copies, sign the undertaking and keep the acknowledgement slip.
The Gaon Panchayat, VCDC or town body checks each family against the eligibility checklist. The District Level Monitoring Committee under the Deputy Commissioner then finalises the list.
The approved list is published and the Finance Department checks the bank details. If an SMS says your details are wrong, correct them at the Gaon Panchayat or ward office.
Rs.1,250 then arrives in her bank account every month by DBT. Keep the account seeded with Aadhaar, or the payment is held back.
If the money stops or the name is missing, call the Orunodoi helpdesk on 1800-202-6256 (working days, 10 am to 6 pm) or meet the Orunodoi Sarothi.
1800-202-6256 — Orunodoi 3.0 helpdesk, Finance Department, Assam (working days, 10 am to 6 pm)
Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni (Nijut Moina)
Directorate of Higher Education, Higher Education Department, Government of Assam

A monthly allowance for girl students in Assam, paid for 10 months a year so that girls keep studying instead of being married off early. A girl in Class 11 or 12 gets Rs.1,000 a month, a degree student Rs.1,250 and a postgraduate or B.Ed student Rs.2,500, whatever the family income. Now in its second phase (Nijut Moina 2.0), it opens every August: the college gives out the form, and the student then submits an online application on the Samarth student portal (degree and PG) or the AHSEC DARPAN portal (Class 11 and 12).
Rs.1,000 (HS), Rs.1,250 (degree) or Rs.2,500 (PG and B.Ed) a month for 10 months a year
Girl students domiciled in Assam, whatever the family income
Studying in HS 1st or 2nd year, a degree course, PG or B.Ed in a government or provincialised institution. Girls in polytechnic courses are covered from 2026-27
She must be unmarried. Married girls are allowed only in PG and B.Ed courses
Not for daughters of Ministers, MPs or MLAs, or for in-service teachers sent to B.Ed on deputation
HS and degree girls who take the Dr. Banikanta Kakati merit scooter cannot get it (they may give up the scooter instead), nor can PG students on the CM's Jibon Prerona scheme
She must have sat the final exam of the previous year and keep regular attendance and discipline
Passbook of her own bank account, seeded with Aadhaar and enabled for Aadhaar-based payment
Mobile number linked to her Aadhaar, for the OTP
Admission receipt or college or school identity card
Signed undertaking, declaration and Aadhaar consent form, signed by the student and a parent
Samarth enrolment number (degree and PG) or DARPAN login (HS), from the college
Mark sheet of the last examination, where the college asks for it

In early August, collect the free Nijut Moina form at your college or HS school office (in 2026-27 the forms were given out from 7 August). Fill it, sign the undertaking with a parent, and hand it in with copies of your Aadhaar and bank passbook. University students get it signed by the Head of Department.
The college checks the form and adds your enrolment number to the Nijut Moina scheme on the Samarth portal.

Open assamshesp.samarth.edu.in and log in with your Samarth enrolment number, password and captcha (first time: click Register and set a password using the email OTP). HS students log in at darpan.ahseconline.in instead, update the profile and verify with Aadhaar.
Click Scholarship, then Apply on the Nijut Moina line. Enter the Aadhaar-seeded bank details, address and last exam, upload the passbook, tick the declarations and click Save & Next.
Check every detail, click Submit and verify with the Aadhaar OTP. Print the acknowledgement and give it to the college before the closing date (5 September in 2026).
The college verifies the applications. Once approved, the money comes to your bank account by DBT every month for 10 months. Missing the exam, indiscipline or getting married stops it.
No dedicated helpline. First ask the Nijut Moina counter or nodal officer at your college; then the Directorate of Higher Education, Kahilipara, Guwahati-19 (directorhigherassam123@gmail.com)
